criteria_v1.degenerate: all selected sets, counts, and depth distributions are identical
criteria_v1.material_depth_variation: maximum selected depth varies or maximum pairwise depth-distribution TVD >= 0.05
criteria_v1.nontrivial: all three variation predicates are true

official_runtime.cold_reset_boundary: fresh OS process, fresh model, rebuilt HSPT, no prior SPT cut or cache
